learning_goal: Test whether trust friction drives adoption more than price

learning_goal: Test whether the assumed bundle is necessary
minimal_test: A/B concept test on bundled versus unbundled offer
success_signal: Unbundled option has equal or higher preference

learning_goal: Test which planning steps are legal versus habitual
minimal_test: Map cadence elements to legal requirements
success_signal: At least two cadence elements are redesignable

minimal_test: Review proposal before implementation design is finalized
